implementation: Canonical Ltd. Ubuntu 22.04 GnuTLS Cryptographic Module (Generic C XTS)
description: GnuTLS implementation providing cryptographic services to Linux user space software components and to its TLS implementation. The module was tested with 64 bit word size. The following cipher implementation is covered: Generic C non-optimized implementation for AES in XTS mode.
